formal_statement: ∀ (m N B : ℕ), 1 ≤ N → 2 * B ≤ N + 1 → ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.funPHPSystem m N) B
plain_statement: For N at least 1 holes, any number of pigeons and 2B at most N + 1, the functional pigeonhole system over F2 has no polynomial calculus refutation of degree B. Razborov, Comput. Complexity 7, 1998, for the degree range; this form is Cor. 4.3 of the unrefereed arXiv:2609.23015. Brute force agrees on 49 small cases and shows the range is tight for N up to 5.
title: HARD LINK: functional pigeonhole has no polynomial calculus refutation over F2 of degree B when the holes number at least 2B - 1
